I’m in: I commit to 18 tons this month if all five explicitly agree, and no more than 3 each if next month’s stock is 20. Before later catches, let’s confirm the actual stock and agree on whole-ton quotas that leave at least 5 tons.

I also agree with Jack: a failed replenishment isn’t evidence of cheating, and retaliatory overfishing would only hurt us all. Kate, you’re the last person we need to hear from—will you join?
